subject: Web Development
subcategory: Famous Websites That Changed the World
title: eBay: Trust Between Strangers
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on eBay: Trust Between Strangers.

hook.text: Pierre Omidyar's first eBay sale was a broken laser pointer for $14.83 in 1995.

buildup.text: eBay created an auction marketplace where anyone could sell anything to anyone worldwide.

discovery.text: The reputation system — buyer and seller ratings — made strangers trust each other online.

twist.text: The buyer of that broken laser pointer knew it was broken. He collected broken laser pointers.

climax.text: eBay proved that trust systems could power an entirely new kind of global economy.

punchline.text: An online reputation system built a global market.
